valid_job.description: A clear job-search request, decoded into the schema on the first try.

repaired.description: The first answer invents a field; the repair turn gets a valid one.

invalid_twice.description: A domain outside the enum, then a confidence outside [0, 1]: repair fails.

low_confidence.description: A vague request the model is honestly unsure about.

unsupported_domain.description: A confident classification into a reserved, not-yet-enabled domain.
